default_exit._why: one exit for every family so rules compete on the same footing; the owner will decide the demo stop/take-profit later and this block changes then (a change = a new screen run, its variants counted again)
default_exit._fills: signal at the close of bar t; market order at the open of the 1-minute bar that starts at t's close (+ slippage); every 1-minute bar from the entry minute on: stop first (fills at the stop or the gap open, - slippage), then the target (a limit: needs a trade 1 tick through, fills at the target); time exit at the open of the first minute at or after entry + max_hold_min; flat at the session's flatten time; one position at a time; at most max_entries_per_session entries per session

E-518.title: Gap-driven micro-break fade
E-518.hypothesis: A short-range break that was built by open-vs-previous-close gaps (aggressive market orders jumping the book) rather than by trading inside bars is a liquidity-taking spike; the book refills and price returns.

E-519.title: Multi-day session-VWAP channel edge fade
E-519.hypothesis: The highest and lowest session VWAPs of recent sessions bound where participants agreed on value; a short-range break that reaches that edge meets inventory holders and tends to fail.

E-520.title: Inside-bar-primed micro-break fade
E-520.hypothesis: A short-range break on the bar right after a small inside bar is a release of a coil by a few stop orders, not a conviction move; fade it.

E-521.title: V-pop micro-break fade
E-521.hypothesis: A big bar that breaks a short-range extreme right after an opposite-colour bar is a one-bar squeeze of stops with no second wave behind it; fade the pop.

E-522.title: Pocket-pivot volume follow
E-522.hypothesis: An up bar on more volume than every down bar of the recent window, above VWAP, shows buyers absorbing all the selling seen lately (and the mirror for sells); follow it.

E-523.title: Awesome Oscillator saucer follow
E-523.hypothesis: In an established momentum phase (AO on one side of zero), two shrinking bars followed by a re-growing one mark a pause that ended; trade with the phase.

E-524.title: Session-extreme two-bar upthrust fade
E-524.hypothesis: A new session high (low) followed at once by a close under its low (over its high) traps breakout buyers (sellers) at the day's edge; their exits feed the reversal.

E-525.title: Time-block micro-break fade
E-525.hypothesis: Liquidity and participant mix change through the day; in some 90-minute blocks short-range breaks mostly fail because the flow behind them is thin.

E-526.title: DeMarker extreme fade
E-526.hypothesis: DeMarker measures how often highs are pushed up versus lows pushed down bar to bar; a reading near an extreme means one side has been extending the range for too long to continue at the same pace.

E-527.title: True Strength Index extreme fade
E-527.hypothesis: A double-smoothed momentum ratio at an extreme means price moved almost one-directionally for a long stretch; late followers become the supply (demand) for the reversal.
